facility: Ko-Kwel Casino Resort (formerly The Mill Casino-Hotel), North Bend OR
agreement: City of North Bend - Coquille Indian Tribe contract for public safety (police and fire) services at the casino; 2010 mediated settlement: the tribe keeps paying for the services and the city provides them
note: Indianz 2010-05-11: the tribe 'agreed to continue paying for police, fire and sewer services'. The World 2020-07: North Bend keeps 24-hour police coverage citing 'a contract for Public Safety services between the city and the Coquille Indian Tribe' (the police chief: the casino contract the city is 'contractually obligated to uphold'); the tribe asked to renegotiate it in July 2020. The tribe states it pays North Bend for police and fire service through a PILOT agreement (coquilletribe.org public services). No 2021-2026 source found on the contract's current terms (searched 2026-10-11). Residual tribal presence (per review e3-tribal-footprints-lar-2025.3, not re-read here): the Coquille Indian Tribe Police Department's August 2017 activity log (coquilletribe.org BOC-10-12-17-8B2) lists Mill Casino/Hotel with 8 of 523 patrol checks (6 of 454 vehicle, 2 of 69 foot). Primary responder attribution: North Bend PD. The block group lies wholly in North Bend city.
